svg.title: Alibi: solving a puzzle, offline (animated)
svg.desc: Animated loop: a nonogram is opened from the cabinet, a hint explains a row from the current board, cells fill, the validator flags a wrong cell, each move autosaves to device-local storage, the lantern lights on solve, and a JSON backup is exported. Works offline.
svg.text: pure engines · reasoning hints from the board · device-local revisioned saves · offline PWA

g.text: Solved · the lantern is lit · see why

svg.text: Pick a family from the cabinet: every puzzle is versioned content
The hint reasons from your current board, never from the stored solution
Pure engines check each move. Every move autosaves on this device
A wrong cell breaks a clue: the validator shows where, and undo restores it
Solved: the lantern lights and the completion explanation opens
Export a JSON backup whenever you like. No account or cloud save
